name: kir-language
description: Syntax highlighting, snippets and language server client for KIR v2 (.kir) files

kir.server.path.description: Command that starts the KIR language server (stdio). Installed by `pip install "kohakunode[lsp]"`.

kir.server.args.description: Extra arguments for the language server command.

kir.sigPath.description: Directories searched for node library signatures; sent to the server as initializationOptions.sigPath.

enumDescriptions: Let the server choose: Rust when the compiled core is available, else Python.
Compute diagnostics and formatting with the Rust core.
Compute diagnostics and formatting with the Python core.
kir.core.description: Core used by the language server for diagnostics and formatting; sent as initializationOptions.core unless auto.
